info.title: HomeRadar Mallorca API
info.description: Headless API that watches low-competition property sources in Mallorca, records every listing change and tells its owner what they can afford. Conventions: kebab-case paths, camelCase JSON, ISO 8601 UTC timestamps, money as {amount, currency}, cursor pagination and RFC 9457 problem details for every error.

get.summary: List listings with simple query-string filters.
get.description:
Quick listing lookup driven by query-string parameters. It is a thin front for `searchListings` with the most common filters
(municipality, price range, source, "new within N hours") and the same cursor envelope. Use `searchListings` for geographic,
history-based or multi-value filters.

Results default to `Active` and `Relisted` listings, newest first (`firstSeenAt`). `daysOnMarket` counts from the publication
date when the source publishes one (Solvia, Aliseda, Inmovilla) and from the first time HomeRadar saw the listing otherwise.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

post.description:
Full-text-free structured search over every listing HomeRadar has ingested. All filters are optional and combine with AND.

**Geography.** `municipalities` compares case-insensitively with the municipality published by the source. `polygonWkt` is a
WKT polygon in WGS84 (`POLYGON((lon lat, …))`) evaluated with PostGIS. `radius` is a circle in metres around a point, evaluated
on an EPSG:25831 projection so distances are metric. Listings without coordinates never match geographic filters.

**History.** `daysOnMarket`, `priceDropsMin`, `cumulativeDropPercentMin` and `newWithinHours` come from the append-only change
log, not from the source: a drop is only counted once HomeRadar has seen both prices.

**Possession.** Bank-owned stock often carries `NoPossession` (occupied, moratorium) or `RentedUntil`; `excludePossession`
removes those. `Unknown` means the source gave no signal.

**Pagination.** Keyset cursors: pass back `nextCursor` unchanged with the same filters and sort. Changing the filters or sort
with an old cursor returns a 400. Sorts: `FirstSeenDesc` (default), `PriceAsc`, `PriceDesc`, `PricePerM2`, `PriceDropDesc`.
Listings without a price sort last for price-based sorts.

Affordability filtering (`financingProfileId`, `budget`) arrives with the analysis engine in phase 2 as an additive change.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.summary: Get a listing with its photos, features and sibling listings.
get.description:
Returns the current state of one listing: summary fields, description, normalised features, photos with their perceptual hash
(once computed) and the cadastral reference when the source publishes it. `features` holds source-specific facts under stable
keys (`elevator`, `terrace`, `parking`, `pool`, `yearBuilt`, `energyRating`, `previousPrice`, `discountPercent`, `badges`,
`condition`, `postalCode`, `address`, `reference`, `campaign`, `specialSituation`, `cadastralParcel`…). `enrichments` holds facts
derived by the rules engine, each labelled with its origin.

`siblingListings` lists other listings of the same physical home once cross-source deduplication (phase 4) has matched them.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.
Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.description:
Lists every stored financing profile. Profiles are seeded from `config/seed/financing-profiles*.yaml` at worker start-up and can
be managed here; a seed with a higher `revision` than the stored one overwrites it, otherwise API edits win.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

post.description:
Creates a financing profile. `key` must be unique. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: the same key with the
same body replays the original response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different body is rejected with 409.

Money is accepted as `{amount, currency}` with `currency` fixed to `EUR`. The response carries a weak `ETag` to use in later
`PUT` calls.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.description: Returns one financing profile. The response carries a weak `ETag` (`W/"<version>"`) that must be sent back as `If-Match` on `PUT`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

put.description:
Replaces a financing profile. `If-Match` is mandatory (428 when missing) and must equal the current `ETag` (412 otherwise), so two
clients never silently overwrite each other. `key` and `revision` are not changed by this operation.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

delete.description: Deletes a financing profile. Analyses that referenced it keep their stored snapshot of the inputs.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.description:
Lists saved searches. Each one is evaluated in memory against every new listing during ingestion with the same specification the
database search uses, and raises an alert on the configured channels when it matches.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

post.summary: Create a saved search with alert channels.
post.description:
Creates a saved search. `filter` uses the `searchListings` schema (sort, cursor and limit are ignored). Searches marked
`priority` make the worker poll their sources' first page every 15 minutes in addition to the full scans. Supports
`Idempotency-Key`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.description: Returns one saved search with its weak `ETag`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

put.description: Replaces a saved search; requires `If-Match` with the current `ETag`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

delete.description: Deletes a saved search. Alerts already queued are still delivered.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.description:
Lists followed listings with their current summary. Any change on a followed listing (price, text, photos, status) is notified
on Telegram with a summarised diff, regardless of saved searches.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

post.summary: Follow a listing; every later change is notified with a diff.
post.description: Starts following a listing. 404 when the listing does not exist, 409 when it is already followed. Supports `Idempotency-Key`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

patch.description:
Updates the follow-up status (`Seen`, `Visited`, `OfferMade`, `Discarded`) and/or notes. Omitted fields keep their value.
Requires `If-Match`.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

delete.description: Stops following a listing. Its history is kept.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.description:
Every registered source with its polling intervals and health. `status` moves to `Degraded` when a run returns no listings after
earlier successful runs or more than 20 % incomplete records (nothing is withdrawn in that case), and to `Failing` after three
consecutive failures; a Telegram alert is sent on every transition.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

get.summary: Recent runs, counters and errors of a source.
get.description:
The source plus its last 20 runs, newest first, with counters (seen, created, changed, withdrawn, errors) and the reason for
degraded or failed runs — for example `robots.txt disallows …` or a schema-change detection.

500.description: Unexpected error; the traceId extension identifies the log entry.

savings.description: Savings available for deposit and costs.

cadastralReference.description: Cadastral reference (20 characters) when the source publishes it.

newWithinHours.description: Only listings first seen within the last N hours (1–720).

statuses.description: Statuses to include; defaults to Active and Relisted.

includeNewBuild.description: Include new-build listings; defaults to true.

dwellingId.description: Physical home grouping several listings, when matched (phase 4).

sellerType.description: Kind of seller behind the source.

externalId.description: Identifier of the listing inside its source.

usableSquareMetres.description: Usable area in m² when published.

zone.description: Zone, street or urbanisation as published.

oneOf.description: Location when the source publishes coordinates.

possession.description: Occupancy as published by the source; critical for bank-owned stock.

firstSeenAt.description: When the listing was first seen by HomeRadar (UTC).

lastSeenAt.description: When the listing was last confirmed online (UTC).

publishedAt.description: Publication date according to the source, when available.

daysOnMarket.description: Days since publication (or since first seen when the source gives no date).

cumulativeDropPercent.description: Total drop since the first price seen, in %.

ListingSummaryDto.description: Compact listing representation used in lists and search results.

MoneyDto.description: Monetary amount. Always two fraction digits.

maxLoanToValue.description: Maximum loan-to-value as a fraction (0.5–1.0). 0.80 is standard; up to 1.00 with an ICO/IBAVI guarantee.

nominalRatePercent.description: Annual nominal rate in % for Fixed, or the fixed leg of Mixed, e.g. 2.9.

spreadPercent.description: Spread over Euríbor in % for Variable or Mixed.

fixedMonths.description: Length of the fixed leg in months for Mixed mortgages.

MortgageTermsDto.description: Mortgage offer assumed for affordability calculations.
